chrono_epoch60.label: file in time order, epoch stamps on 60% of records

chrono_field100.label: file in time order, a time field on every record

chrono_field30.label: file in time order, a time field on 30% of records

grouped_epoch60.label: file grouped by agent, epoch stamps on 60% of records

benign_leaderboard.label: many agents push results to one shared leaderboard dataset and read it for the best

benign_ci.label: one release bot writes a status dataset; CI-style agents poll it every ~10 minutes

benign_coordinator.label: a coordinator hands tasks through one dataset; workers return results through another

benign_cloud.label: honest agents on cloud machines: metadata for the region, cluster API for pod status, results to their own dataset

benign_plain.label: plain agents that read one public reference dataset
